Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear map. A few quick clarifications from legal: 

- Data residency: MegaCare requires processing and storage of PHI-derived metadata in our US/EU-controlled zones only. We can accept a late-binding schedule for specific sub-regions but not for the core residency clause.
- Audit rights: we need audit log retention and the ability to request SOC2 evidence within 10 business days. Can Redwood confirm SOC2 Type II latest report ETA?
- Liability cap: we are open to a negotiated mutual cap but want to preserve carve-outs for data breach and regulatory fines.

Procurement note (ProcureOps): we prefer DocuSign with a PO attached. Simon (cc'd) will confirm the PO lead and payment terms (Net30 vs Net45).

I can do a 30 minute call Friday 10am ET to run through the flagged clauses. Laura — can you pull the updated pricing bands so we can confirm what stays late-binding?

Best,
Maria Ortega
Head of Legal — Contracts & Privacy | MegaCare Health

Following up with a sequencing proposal to minimize gating risk — annotated against the MAP (see tab 'Sequence'):

1) Legal narrow-scope sign-off (MSA baseline + DPA core residency and audit rights) — target: Fri 11/13 EOD. This must be complete before procurement issues PO.
2) Order form circulation (DocuSign) with pricing bands marked as "provisional" — target: Mon 11/16. We accept final rate lock within 30 days of signature.
3) Pilot provisioning: dedicated sandbox and dataset ingress validation — target: provisioning within 48 hours of DocuSign completion.
4) Acceptance window: 30-day pilot with 2 checkpoints (day 7 and day 21). Production onboarding gated on successful acceptance and a signed order form finalization addendum (if pricing bands changed).

If Maria confirms SOC2 report ETA (we will provide the latest report and SOC2 audit letter), we can treat audit evidence as satisfied for step 1. For liability carve-outs, propose an escalation path to Exec Sponsor instead of blocking signature.

Risk note: the primary blocker is any non-negotiable on encryption in transit that differs from our standard offering. We should capture that as an absolute in the MAP and mark the procurement milestone as blocked until clarified.

I'll update the MAP and push out MAP_v1b in the Drive folder after Friday's legal call.

—Karthik
